data.title: One Piece of meat
data.solution:
import sys
import math

m = int(input())
k = int(input())
c = int(input())
t = int(input())

# Calculate days, rounding up for any partial days
days_needed = math.ceil(k / c)
meat_needed = days_needed * m

if t >= meat_needed:
    print("SHISHISHI")
else:
    missing_meat = meat_needed - t
    print(f"I'm hungry Sandy, I need {missing_meat} more kg of meat!")
data.statement:
Champanzee D. Lucy is a very hungry pirate. He needs to eat exactly [[m]]-kg of meat per day to survive.

His ship is currently sailing to the next island, which is [[k]]-km away. The ship travels at a constant speed of [[c]]-km per day.

You are given the total amount of meat [[t]]-kg currently available on the ship. Determine if there is enough meat to sustain Lucy until the ship arrives at the island. If there isn't, calculate exactly how much more meat he needs and output that amount [[a]].

Note: The ship arrives instantly at the end of the calculated days. If the travel time is a fraction, Lucy still needs to eat for the full fractional day (for example, a 1.2 day trip requires 2 full days of meat).

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Champanzee D. Lucy is a very hungry pirate. He needs to eat exactly m-kg of meat per day to survive.

His ship is currently sailing to the next island, which is k-km away. The ship travels at a constant speed of c-km per day.

You are given the total amount of meat t-kg currently available on the ship. Determine if there is enough meat to sustain Lucy until the ship arrives at the island. If there isn't, calculate exactly how much more meat he needs and output that amount a.

Note: The ship arrives instantly at the end of the calculated days. If the travel time is a fraction, Lucy still needs to eat for the full fractional day (for example, a 1.2 day trip requires 2 full days of meat).
Input
Line 1: m — The meat Lucy eats per day (in kg).
Line 2: k — The distance to the next island (in km).
Line 3: d — The distance the ship travels per day (in km).
Line 4: t — The total meat currently on the ship (in kg).
Output
A single line: SHISHISHI if there is enough meat
A single line: I'm hungry Sandy, I need a more kg of meat! if the meat runs out before arrival. With a being the amount of meat (in kg) needed for Lucy to be sustained by the time they reach the island.
Constraints
1 <= m <= 10000
1 <= k <= 10000
1 <= d <= 10000
1 <= t <= 10000
Example
Input
5
100
50
20
Output
SHISHISHI
